desc: Derive and justify that for a candidate K, using the K smallest mochi as tops and K largest as bottoms is sufficient.
Implement the feasibility predicate with checks \(2A_i \le A_{N-K+i}\) and binary search over \(0 \le K \le \lfloor N/2\rfloor\).
Verify boundary cases such as no possible pair, all possible pairs, duplicate sizes, and \(N=2\).
Produce the final Python program that reads stdin and prints the maximum number of kagamimochi.
